data.narrative:
Naifo Technologies is a Series C robotics and manufacturing company founded by Aymeric Barthes and Gaëtan Sévérac, having raised €54.7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of 9 private robotics firms and 1 public comparable, with primary focus on 3 same-sector, same-stage peers: Hadrian ($1.6B), Agile Robots ($1.0B), and Nimble Robotics ($1.0B).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the €54.7M raised as a proxy base value and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, yielding $93M. Peer-median methodology benchmarks Naifo against the three comps identified above, which exhibit a median valuation of $1.0B with a range of $1.0B to $1.6B.

The divergence between methods reflects material uncertainty in growth trajectory and market positioning. The analysis supports a valuation range of $79M (conservative floor anchored to stage progression) to $1.1B (upper bound near peer median), with a midpoint of $546M. The wide range underscores key sensitivities: capital efficiency relative to peer benchmarks, revenue traction not specified in available data, and whether Naifo's technology and market access justify positioning toward the peer median versus the stage-based floor. Resolution of these factors through revenue and unit economics disclosure would narrow the range materially.
